The large scythe has a long handle in a reflective light yellow gold and a curved blade in reddish-orange gold. The number XIII is printed at the top center of the card. A black border surrounds the white background of the card, and the illustration is contained within this border. The edges of all elements have a dissolving quality, scattering golden particles.
